resolution: torchcodec 0.17.0+cpu linked against the FFmpeg 8 libraries bundled with PyAV 17.1.0; everything on this page was then rerun in one dedicated rjob CPU allocation. Rows and checks were not merged across runs.

sdk_client_side_rejections.detail: valen-sdk 0.5.0 and @valen-team/sdk 0.4.0 reject these two invalid requests in the client with ValenInputError before sending them; the SDK check scripts count only HTTP 4xx responses, so their reports mark the two cases as not passed. The services themselves return HTTP 400 for both in the contract fixture.
